question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) When he arrived at the farm he saw a farmer standing outside surrounded by many three legged chickens. (b) The farmer replied 'yes, I breed them because my wife and my son live here and we all like to eat chicken legs so I breed them like in this way. (c) The man decided to drive faster to see if the chicken could follow the speed. As he went faster and faster, so did the chicken. (d) One day, a man was driving in the country side when he saw a there legged chickens running down the road next to this car. (e) "Are these your chickens"? the man asked. (f) "I don't know. I haven't caught one yet". (g) Suddenly the chickens stopped running next to the car and ran down a country roads towards a farm. The man decided to follow the chickens to the farm. SSC English (h) "That's amazing!" said the driver." How do they taste?" R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (d) + (c) + (g) + (a) + (e) + (b) + (h) + (f) Section B : Writing Test
